lessons.title: My Weekend
lessons.titleNative: میرا ہفتہ وار چھٹی کا دن
lessons.context: A short story about how someone spent their weekend.

paragraphs.urdu: گزشتہ ہفتے میرا ایک دن بہت خوبصورت تھا۔
paragraphs.en: Last week, one of my days was very beautiful.

paragraphs.urdu: صبح میں اپنے دوستوں کے ساتھ باغ گیا۔
paragraphs.en: In the morning I went to the garden with my friends.

paragraphs.urdu: ہم نے وہاں کھیل کھیلا اور بہت ہنسے۔
paragraphs.en: We played a game there and laughed a lot.

paragraphs.urdu: دوپہر کو ہم نے ایک اچھے ہوٹل میں کھانا کھایا۔
paragraphs.en: In the afternoon we ate food at a good restaurant.

paragraphs.urdu: شام کو میں گھر آیا اور اپنے خاندان کے ساتھ رہا۔
paragraphs.en: In the evening I came home and stayed with my family.

questions.question: Where did the person go in the morning?
What did they do at the park?
options: They played a game and laughed

questions.question: Where did they eat in the afternoon?
What did they do in the evening?

lessons.title: A Letter to a Friend
lessons.context: A short letter about future plans.

paragraphs.urdu: پیارے دوست، امید ہے تم ٹھیک ہو گے۔
paragraphs.en: Dear friend, I hope you are well.

paragraphs.urdu: میں اگلے مہینے ایک نئے شہر جاؤں گا۔
paragraphs.en: I will go to a new city next month.

paragraphs.urdu: وہاں میں ایک نئی نوکری شروع کروں گا۔
paragraphs.en: There I will start a new job.

paragraphs.urdu: مجھے تھوڑا ڈر بھی لگتا ہے اور خوشی بھی ہوتی ہے۔
paragraphs.en: I feel a little scared but also happy.

paragraphs.urdu: امید ہے کہ ہم جلد ملیں گے اور تمہیں سب کچھ بتاؤں گا۔
paragraphs.en: I hope we meet soon and I will tell you everything.

questions.question: What will the writer do next month?
How does the writer feel?
options: A little scared and also happy

questions.question: What does the writer hope for?
options: To meet soon and tell everything
